pages.title: Geodesic Anchor
pages.text: A device that keeps its bearer's worldline intact inside a black or white hole. Without it, tidal forces and causal chaos are lethal within seconds. It is heavy and cool and hums faintly, like a gyroscope.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole I nearly lost my worldline. Combining a Kerr metric shard, graviton crystal and chronon capacitor in a hyperlattice frame on the Extreme Assembly Table, I built an anchor to keep it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.
